errors.text_span: Секторът "Рекламни слогани с реторични фигури" е зает с 12,39%, представен от червено.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the sector for "Advertising slogans with rhetorical figures". The chart shows this sector represents 87.61% and is colored blue, not 12.39% and red.
The numerical value 77.61% does not appear anywhere in the chart. The machine likely intended to use the value 87.61% but made a typographical error.
The phrase "Не сектор" is grammatically incorrect in Bulgarian. A correct phrasing would be "Нито един сектор не е визуално подчертан" (No sector is visually highlighted).
